verdict.rationale: Ramp documents multi-entity support within a single consolidated account, with per-entity spend policies and controls, and it syncs transaction and reimbursement data to multiple entities in one step, which approximates per-entity books. Multi-currency is evidenced only for employee reimbursements (40 currencies), and eligibility requires US registration with most operations in the US. Missing for 10: documented consolidated cross-entity reporting, multi-currency entity books or ledgers beyond reimbursements, support for non-US legal entities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run multiple legal entities and currencies in one account with consolidated reporting and per-entity books

citations.quote: Ramp scales to tackle complex spend policies and controls for each entity all in a single consolidated Ramp account
Sync your transaction and reimbursement data to multiple entities in a single step, for less work.
Reimburse employees with confidence in more than 70 countries and 40 currencies
